notes.title: First Gameplay Video and Some development details
The first trailer and new details of Midnight Ohota
notes.content:
Dear friends! We are happy to present you the first trailer for our new project, Midnight Ohota!

[previewyoutube=AmN6ZvZAh9M;full][/previewyoutube]

It shows the main gameplay of the game, which includes both the previously announced core mechanics and features (wild flight through stylish levitating rings and the destruction of barraging airships under the most powerful post-punk rubilovo, for example), and new ones. Among which are:


 Blocks with unguided aircraft missiles under the wing of fashionable fighter jets, with which you can destroy any moving and stationary targets;
 Flying retro-futuristic cars that perfectly explode from missiles;
 Containers with valuable cargo that were stolen from one stranded container ship (it will also be added later);
 Destruction of the above-mentioned objects and airships using missiles with procedurally generated (no) particles.


 Innovations
